t: In front of you is a statue of Sir Sydney Waterlow, set in Waterlow Park. Waterlow was a philanthropist and Liberal politician, and he is remembered above all for giving this park to the public as a garden for the gardenless. That generous idea is why his likeness stands here. The statue was made by Frank Mowbray Taubman, an English sculptor who also worked as a medallist and painter. So you are looking at a tribute to the man whose gift opened this green space to everyone.
